received_works.body:
シロワニさん⭐️COEIROINK®︎🌙さん，hello——
I love your works very much. ❤️.I'd like to invite you to draw  my original character. 
She is a antiquarian. Her personality is very easygoing and gentle, a little unsure of herself. As a qualified social animal, she has been working hard to complete the task, in Japan and even abroad to carry out antique acquisition and after-sales work. In fact, she has a dual personality, the second personality (male) is mainly to help her when she encounters danger, and the two people will quarrel through the diary.  They encountered a lot of supernatural events, two people rely on diary communication together through the difficulties. (The male personality is a little flirtatious, and the two of them will argue in the diary, but in fact, they care about each other very much) .Her representatives are oranges, notes and morning glory.
Thank you (*^o^*)
